name: Command & Control
summary: Amarok — the pack's troubleshooting and remediation executor over navi action push (SSH to Linux hosts, navi.db assets or ANY IP / hostname / small CIDR). Built-in read-only diagnostics (Quick health incl. the host's public egress IP, network, security posture, Tenable agent, resources), credential tests that tell auth failures from unreachable / port closed / DNS / timeout / a CHANGED host key, 'does this path exist?' (stat + sha256), AI-assisted remediation (Tenable's Solution → strict JSON plan → deterministic validator → canary-first deploy with per-step verify and rollback), and free-form commands / file pushes / armed campaigns. Every remote action is TRIPLE-gated (writes + NAVI_REMOTE_CODE_EXECUTION + confirm); every command on every host lands in the hash-chained C2 log (never the reply). Other hounds hand paths and vulns over via sessionStorage — pre-filled, never auto-run.
